name: place_cables
summary: Lay a cable run, or pieces, as a coil builds it: the one-cell piece whose ends match each cell, of a grade (heavy by default). Guards for bridging, splitting and overload. Dry run by default; confirm to build.

help.text: Pieces come from the loaded coil of the grade (normal, heavy or super_heavy), never a table. Coils come from from_id (default the player); not_enough_coils names what is missing. A burnt cable an overload left may be named in remove_ids, freeing its cell.

overload.text: would_overload: a network after the edit would carry min(potential, required), pooled over what it joins, above its weakest cable (the game burns a cable every power tick). The load is estimated from each device's own state: a battery's charge and free capacity, an APC's or transformer's supply and demand, a solar panel's or generator's rate, a consumer's draw while on and built; only ports in the device's power role count. Where a removal splits a network, each part is checked with the whole old network's numbers.

when_on.summary: The warning for devices that are off.
when_on.text: would_overload_when_on (a warning, never a refusal): safe as the devices stand, but switching on every device on that network that is off (each at the game's ceiling: a station battery's maximum on output and input, an APC's maximum, a power transmitter's 5000 W) would burn a cable at once, such as two full batteries joined while both are off. It follows APCs, transformers and transmitters whose input is on the network, up to 8 deep. The message names the off devices: keep them off, use a higher grade, or keep the networks apart.

remove_ids.description: Cable pieces removed in the same job before building (see runs/assume_removed).

reference_id.description: A device or piece on the network.

join_to.description: The cable network the run must end up on (see runs/taps).

from_id.description: The thing whose inventory gives the coils or kits and takes the refund. Default the player.

refund.description: Give back what removed pieces and cheaper changes return. Default true; false is refund_to none.

limit.description: Cells listed; default 5, 0 for none. All are counted and checked.
